prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1201; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the presentation is plausible for a collision of this type. Examination demonstrated tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction, and pain with resisted rotation. Imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury identified on examination. The patient's history includes a minor strain to the same shoulder several years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation and did not require ongoing care. Treatment over three visits consisted of supervised range-of-motion exercises, activity modification, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. Care followed a typical course, with progressive improvement in strength and pain scores, and visit frequency tapered as the patient recovered. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each encounter. At the final visit the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was discharged to a home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
